content.title: LSG vs GT IPL 2026 Highlights: Buttler, Gill fifties lead Gujarat Titans to seven-wicket win
content.text: Home Cricket IPL LSG vs GT, IPL 2026: Catch all the updates and highlights from the IPL 2026 match between Lucknow Super Giants and Gujarat Titans at the Ekana Stadium, Lucknow on Sunday, April 12. Updated : Apr 12, 2026 19:18 IST Shubman Gill and Jos Buttler are batting for GT. | Photo Credit: REUTERS Shubman Gill and Jos Buttler are batting for GT. | Photo Credit: REUTERS elcome to Sportstar’s highlights of the IPL 2026 match between Lucknow Super Giants and Gujarat Titans at the Ekana Stadium, Lucknow on Sunday, April 12. Welcome to Sportstar’s coverage of IPL match between Lucknow Super Giants and Gujarat TitansLucknow Super Giants164 / 8 (20 OV)Gujarat Titans165 / 3 (18.4 OV)Gujarat Titans win by 7 wicketsFOR SCORECARD CHECK MATCH CENTRE LSG vs GT, IPL 2026: Gujarat Titans registers comprehensive seven-wicket win over Lucknow Super Giants LSG vs GT, IPL 2026: Gujarat Titans registers comprehensive seven-wicket win over Lucknow Super GiantsJos Buttler and Shubman Gill’s half-centuries helped Gujarat Titans beat Lucknow Super Giants by seven wickets at the Ekana Stadium in Lucknow on Sunday afternoon. Gujarat Titans wins by seven wickets A clinical, somewhat old-fashioned, chase from Gujarat Titans again there. Shubman Gill took his time, picking off boundaries and keeping the strike ticking over, while Jos Buttler looked in regal touch as he continued his resurgence with the bat this season.Both batters fell before the end, but Washington Sundar was on hand to finish of the match and ensure that the visitor leaves Ekana Stadium with two points. GT live score: 165/3 in 18.4 overs Markram to close things out, Tewatia lofted it straight and it just evades Pooran at long-off. Tewatia looks to reverse, and it runs away for a bye. Sundar pushes to long-off, and Gujarat Titans wins by seven wickets. GT live score: 159/3 in 18 overs Prince Yadav for his final over. Tewatia takes a quick single to cover. Washington pushes a leg-stump yorker away for one. Short ball, and it’s called wide. Guided away for one more. Leg-stump half-volley, and Washington pumps it away for four! Below run-a-ball now. Short ball, and Washington hooks it away for six! GT needs six runs to win. GT live score: 145/3 in 17 overs Aiden Markram is going to bowl, must be to counter the two left-handers. Tewatia cuts the first ball for one. Four! Washington backs away and looks to hit over covers, just evades the diving long-off for four. Chopped down for a quick single.Oh, he’s beaten Tewatia on the outside edge! Quick single again. Washington cuts away two more to end the over. GT needs 20 from the final three overs. GT live score: 136/3 in 16 overs Shami to close out. Sundar cuts to point. Worked to long-on for one. Glorious batting from Buttler, eases it over covers for four more. What a catch! Buttler doesn’t read the slower ball as he looks to hit straight, Aiden Markram keeps his nerve to athletically complete the catch. Jos Buttler c Aiden Markram b Mohammed Shami 60 (37b)Rahul Tewatia is in at five. Worked away for one to leg. Washington defends to cover, 29 needed in 24 now. GT live score: 130/2 in 15 overs Prince Yadav is back with the equation 37 runs needed from 36 balls. Buttler looks to pull, and miscues it back towards the bowler. Buttler has an almighty heave and misses. Worked to long-on for one. Gone! Gill is out! Short from Prince, Gill looks to pull and gloves it behind. LSG stays alive?Shubman Gill c Rishabh Pant b Prince Yadav 56 (40b)Washington Sundar is the next batter in. Inside-edge gives him one, GT needs 35 from five overs now. GT live score: 128/1 in 14 overs Linde gets a third, gets one to turn slightly and clips Buttler on the pad. Buttler clips one to the off-side sweeper, and that brings up his 29-ball fifty, his second on the bounce. Gill looks to hit straight, and it lands short of Mukul at long-on. Reverse-sweep from Buttler, runs away for four. Pushed to long-off for one. GT live score: 121/1 in 13 overs Digvesh to bowl out. Gill looks to sweep and misses. Advances and drives to long-off. Wide down leg from Digvesh. And another glorious drive over covers for four more! Buttler on the charge. Pushed to long-on for one. Gill taps the ball into the gap for yet another double. And then two more again. GT needs 44 more to win. GT live score: 110/1 in 12 overs Avesh now, Buttler takes a single. Gill pulls a single, and that completes a mature 34-ball fifty for the GT skipper. Buttler slaps through covers for two more. Ramped, and it runs away for four more! Oh Buttler is seeing it beautifully, cuts behind point for another boundary. Three in a row! Full, and Buttler pumps it over mid-off. GT live score: 94/1 in 11 overs Digvesh for his third, Gill works to short fine. Qucik single to short point. Punched to cover. Comedy of errors! Buttler drops a single into the off-side, and three fielders run into each other. Shot! Backs away and pushes over covers for four. Tapped into the leg-side for one to end the over. GT live score: 86/1 in 10 overs Avesh Khan into the attack. A dot to begin the over. Slower ball but too wide outside off - wide ball. Gill with a short-arm jab and takes a double. Slower bouncer; a dot ball. Takes a single next ball. Bouncer and Buttler just slaps the ball in front of midwicket for four! Very nice shot that. A dot to end the over. GT live score: 78/1 in 9 overs Linde. Gill comes down the track and lofts the ball over point for four! Follows it up with a single. Now Buttler cuts past point and gets another boundary. Buttler defends next ball. Another defence, another dot. A dot to end the over. GT live score: 69/1 in 8 overs Digvesh continues. Gill defends the first ball. A single off the next ball. Dropped! Buttler got an outside edge and Pant couldn’t grab it. The ball deviated a lot there, was a tough catch. Four singles so far in the over. Five runs from the over. GT live score: 64/1 in 7 overs George Linde into the attack. Buttler cuts and gets a boundary off the first ball. Now a single in that same region. Gill takes a single. Buttler gives him the strike back. Gill cuts and gets a boundary towards deep third region. Gill takes a single off the last ball. GT live score: 52/1 in 6 overs Digvesh Rathi into the attack. He strikes first ball! Sudharsan tried to ramp over short fine leg fielder but is caught. Digvesh takes out his signature celebration as well! Sudharsan goes for 15 off 14 balls. Jos Buttler in at three. A dot to begin with. He’s off the mark with a quick single. Gill takes a single. Buttler pushes the ball past cover fielder and will get his first boundary. Buttler chips and ball falls just short of long on fielder, just a single. GT live score: 45/0 in 5 overs Shami continues. Gill with a short-arm jab but the fielder in the deep does well to keep it down to just a couple. Gill defends the next ball. Now Gill picks the length ball and guides it towards fine leg region for four. Now he picks the length ball and lofts his straight drive and gets a SIX! Beautiful shot. Now he punches the ball towards cover region and the ball reaches the fence, another four! Gill ends the over with a brilliant lofted flick for four. GT live score: 25/0 in 4 overs Shami has walked off the field after that over. Prince Yadav continues. Sudharsan takes a single off the first ball. Gill plays a dot. Gill drives straight back to Prince and he has hurt his thumb in that process. Was struck very hard. Prince is getting a treatment now. He’s back now. Three dot balls. Now a single towards square leg. Sudharsan finishes the over with a four. A cut past point. GT live score: 19/0 in 3 overs Shami. Starts off with a couple of dot balls against Gill. He slashes and gets a single towards deep backward point region. Sudharsan plays a dot. Now Shami has called the physio. A brief meeting with the physio and now he’s back at the mark. Bowls a short ball and Sudharsan leaves it. A single to end the over. GT live score: 17/0 in 2 overs Prince Yadav from the other end. On the pads, Gill flicks towards midwicket and gets a double. Takes a quick single next ball. Sudharsan takes a single as well. Four! On the pads again and this time Gill has enough power on the shot to send the ball towards fence. Short ball, Gill pulls for a single. A dot to end the over. GT live score: 8/0 in 1 over Mohammed Shami with the new ball. Shubman Gill and Sai Sudharsan open the innings. Sudharsan on strike. A dot to begin with. Now Sudharsan drives through the cover region and gets a boundary early into his innings. Another dot. Sudharsan unable to find the gap again, dot. Dot again at the same point region. Now he finds the gap finally as he ends the over with another cover drive for four. Gujarat Titans needs 165 to win A curious innings that threatened to get going a fair few times, but in truth never did. The GT bowlers struck regularly, utilising the back-of-a-length and short balls to pry out batters.Prasidh Krishna has now reclaimed the Purple Cap with his four wickets, while Rashid Khan and Mohammed Siraj bowled magnificently as well. That said, this is a decidely tricky wicket to bat on, and the late flow of runs has managed to push it up to 164 for eight. Shubman Gill, B. Sai Sudharsan, and Co. will have their work cut out for them, how will they fare?Stay with us to find out. LSG live score: 164/8 in 20 overs Ashok Sharma, and Shami has picked it up over the leg-side for six! Dropped a sitter! Shami backs away and slaps it straight to Rashid at deep cover, but he fumbles it and falls. And now Linde swings it over short fine for four more! The runs are flowing. Slower ball, and Linde chips it up...well held by Shahrukh! Good catch running in.George Linde c Shahrukh Khan b Ashok Sharma 16 (10b)Avesh Khan is the new batter, and he’s slapped it straight for four more! Headed down leg, and Avesh has jumped out of the way of it! It’s called wide...GT reviews and the call stays. Misses again...and the batters run a bye.So, Lucknow Super Giants finishes on 164 for eight. LSG live score: 146/7 in 19 overs Slower bouncer, and Mukul has nicked it behind! Big blow for LSG, Prasidh has a fourth!Mukul Choudhary c Jos Buttler b Prasidh Krishna 18 (14b)Mohammed Shami is the new man. Shot! Guided away past point for four. Has an almight hoick for one. Four! Thick edge runs past fine leg for four more. Slower ball edged over fine leg for two more! And four more! Upper cut over short third. Much needed injection of runs for LSG. LSG live score: 131/6 in 18 overs Rabada to bowl out, on a length, and Mukul has swung it over leg for six! Pulled along the floor for two. Keeps pulling, this time for one. Linde works it back to the bowler. Under-edge for one more to Linde. Wristily flicked by Mukul again...just lands short of the fielder for a single. LSG live score: 120/6 in 17 overs Ashok Sharma with two in the tank. Starts short and it clocks Mukul on the grill, runs away for a single. Short ball, and Samad has pulled it straight to Phillips at deep midwicket! Abdul Samad c Phillips b Ashok Sharma 18 (22b)George Linde, on IPL debut, is the new man as the LSG Impact Player. Ayush Badoni is out. Shahrukh Khan has been brought in as the Impact Player for GT as well. Linde misses the pull first ball. Pulled away for one, Linde is off the mark. Mukul taps away a single. Pinned on the back leg, decent shout but not given. LSG live score: 117/5 in 16 overs Siraj to bowl out, and nearly a run-out first ball! Would have been gone with a direct hit. Four! Short ball, and Mukul top-edges it away past the keeper. Quick single through covers. Short from Siraj again, and Samad only half gets out of the way. It runs off the gloves for one. Mukul takes another quick single to covers. LSG 110/5 in 15 overs Prasidh again, cuts Pooran in half! Good bowling. Can’t flick it away now. Gone! Soft dismissal! Slower ball bouncer, and Pooran just pats it to Gill at mid-off. Nicholas Pooran c Shubman Gill b Prasidh Krishna 19 (21b)The hero of the KKR game, Mukul Choudhary, is in. Off the mark with a single to long-on. Samad defends to point. LSG live score: 109/4 in 14 overs Rashid to bowl out, will Pooran chance his arm against him? Not first ball, defended again. He does second ball, it goes uuuuuupppp....and just gets over the rope! Six more, better timing now and Pooran is away! Cut off the stumps to point. Goes straight again, and it lands at long-off on the bounce. Ooh, nearly a caught and bowled to end the over, Rashid can’t quite cling on with a dive in his follow-through. LSG live score: 96/4 in 13 overs Rabada again, Pooran defends to point. Worked away for one more. Four! Much needed, nothing wrong with the ball, Samad edges it fine and it runs away. Four! More confident, pull shot in the gap and it runs away for four. Snorter from Rabada, Samad weaves out of the way. Rabada is asking for a caught behind, and Gill has reviewed it! Doesn’t seem to be any bat on it...yep no bat involved. Dot to end the over.Nine from the over, a much needed injection of haste for LSG. LSG live score: 87/4 in 12 overs Rashid Khan into his third. Samad defends but the bowler misfields in his followthrough. Pooran drives down the ground for one. Worked away for one more. Pooran defends. Chopped away for one more. Just three from the over. LSG live score: 83/4 in 11 overs Ashok is back. Samad plays a dot. Samad tucks away towards fine leg and gets a double. Now a dot. A single via leg bye now. Dot again. Too many dot balls played by LSG. Bouncer and Pooran ducks to end the over. LSG 80/4 in 10 overs Rashid. A single off the first ball. Another single. A dot now. Another dot by Samad. Third consecutive dot. A single to end the over. LSG live score: 77/4 in 9 overs Prasidh continues. A dot to begin. OUT! Badoni is gone! Short ball, Badoni went for the pull and is caught in the deep. Another one bites the dust. Abdul Samad is the new man in. Samad takes a double off his first ball. Now he cuts and takes a single. Pooran defends, a dot. And a dot end the over. LSG live score: 74/3 in 8 overs Rashid Khan into the attack. Badoni takes a single first ball. Nicholas Pooran is off the mark with a single. Another single. Fourth single off the over now. Badoni sweeps....and takes a single. A dot to end the over. LSG live score: 69/3 in 7 overs Prasidh is into the attack, Badoni clips a single off the hip. A little straight, and it deflects off the thigh pad to short fine. Ooh, squares his up with a ripper that somehow evades the outside edge.Half-volley on leg, Markram flicks it aerially....and a diving Phillips puts it down! He made all the ground running to his left and took the catch, but it bounced out of his hands as his elbows hit the ground. And escapes again! Uppish punch from Markram, and it brushes cover’s fingers as it runs away for four.He finally has his man now! Justice for Prasidh. On a length, Markram pulls but picks out Washington Sundar at deep midwicket who does well to stay inside the ropes. First for Prasidh, and LSG has lost its top three.Aiden Markram c Washington Sundar b Prasidh Krishna 30 (21b) LSG live score: 60/2 in 6 overs Ashok Sharma into the attack. A dot to begin with. Markram plays a lofted on drive and sends the ball over long on for a six! Lovely striking. Follows it up with a dot. Markram now gives the strike to Badoni. Cracking cover drive by the youngster. Beautifully sent to the fence. A single to end the PowerPlay. LSG live score: 48/2 in 5 overs Siraj for his third. Pant goes for a slog and ends up hitting very high in the air. Tewatia settles under the ball and completes the catch. Pant is gone after scoring 18 off 11 balls. Ayush Badoni at four. He gets off the strike with a single via leg bye. Markram plays a dot next ball. Markram takes a quick single next ball. Badoni plays a dot. Bouncer and it’s too short, a wide. A dot to end the over. LSG live score: 45/1 in 4 overs Rabada. A dot to begin with. Pant pulls the next ball towards midwicket for SIX! Brilliant hit that. Takes a single next ball. Wanted to slog on that occasion as well. Markram picks the leg stumps delivery towards cow corner for another four. Sweetly timed shot. Followed by a dot ball. A four to end the over. Markram flicks it towards square leg region. LSG live score: 30/1 in 3 overs Siraj. Pant begins with a splendid cover drive for four! Perfect shot, leaned onto that shot. Tries to ramp but can’t middle it. A dot. Pant taps and takes a single. Markram takes a single the next ball. Bouncer by Siraj and Pant can’t time his bat swing, a dot. A quick single to end the over. LSG live score: 23/1 in 2 overs Kagiso Rabada into the attack. Marsh welcomes him with a lofted on drive for a six! Beautiful shot. He follows it up with a four. An inside edge just past the stumps. Lucky one. OUT! This time Marsh is caught at mid off. Fuller length, Marsh went for the lofted drive but it went straight to the fielder. Rishabh Pant in at three. He comes down the track first ball and smacks Rabada over mid off for four! Cuts and takes a single towards deep third. Markram finishes the over with a four. Tucked away towards fine leg. LSG live score: 4/0 in 1 over Mitchell Marsh and Aiden Markram open the innings. Mohammed Siraj with the new ball.Hard length, Markram defends the outswinger. Another outswinger, Markram drives to mid off fielder, a dot. Now Markram pushes the ball towards square leg and gets a double. A single off a leg bye now. Marsh is off the mark with a single. A play and a miss to end the over. Gujarat Titans Impact Player options M. Shahrukh Khan, Manav Suthar, Jason Holder, Kulwant Khejroliya, Anuj Rawat. Gujarat Titans playing XI Shubman Gill, B. Sai Sudharsan, Jos Buttler, Washington Sundar, Glenn Phillips, Rahul Tewatia, Rashid Khan, Kagiso Rabada, Mohammed Siraj, Ashok Sharma, Prasidh Krishna. Lucknow Super Giants Impact Player options M. Siddharth, George Linde, Shahbaz Ahmed, Mayank Yadav, Matthew Breetzke. Lucknow Super Giants playing XI Mitchell Marsh, Aiden Markram, Rishabh Pant (c), Ayush Badoni, Nicholas Pooran, Abdul Samad, Mukul Choudhary, Mohammed Shami, Avesh Khan, Digvesh Rathi, Prince Yadav. Gujarat Titans won the toss and chose to bowl first Rishabh Pant spins the coin, Shubman Gill calls heads....Gujarat Titans wins the toss and choses to bowl first. Says it looks like a good wicket, and that it’s always good to have a total to chase. Says that the win in the last match is a sigh of relief. Same team for GT.Pant says it doesn’t matter too much whether his side is batting or bowling first. Says that winning is a boost, but that his side will have to be at its best today, and that his side needs to show intent on the field. Same team for LSG as well. Pitch report The Ekana Stadium pitch has produced a large range of scores in recent, and has some patches of brown on it. The pitch is generally on the slower side, but Michael Clarke reckons the pitch will play decently for the batters.It is also “piping hot” according to Ian Bishop, which could make the surface break up as the day progresses. Is Rashid Khan back to his best? Rashid Khan has struggled in the last two seasons for Gujarat Titans, having had his worst two seasons in the IPL back-to-back in 2024 and 2025. He managed 10 wickets in 2024 and nine wickets in 2025, with a rising economy rate in both seasons.However, he has started 2026 in strong form, managing five wickets in three matches at an economy of just over 7 runs per over. Can Pooran finally come good? Nicholas Pooran was one of the standouts of Lucknow Super Giants’ IPL 2025 campaign, scoring 524 runs at a remarkable strike-rate of 196.25, and established himself as one of the most dangerous hitters of spin in the tournament.He has found 2026 tough in comparison, managing just 22 runs from his three innings at a paltry strike-rate of 81.48. Will today be the day he comes good? History beckons for Shubman Gill Gujarat Titans captain Shubman Gill is just 25 runs away from becoming the second-fastest Indian to score 4000 runs in IPL today afternoon. If he completes the milestone this afternoon, he will do it in 118 matches, quicker than Virat Kohli (128 innings) and behind only KL Rahul (105 innings) for Indians. A new face in the LSG camp Lucknow Super Giants has a new face to call upon tonight, having signed up South African all-rounder George Linde as a replacement for the injured Wanindu Hasaranga. Linde, who has played nearly 40 T20Is for the Proteas, is a left-arm spinner and lower-order hitter. Can LSG continue its winning run against GT? Lucknow Super Giants won both of its matches against Gujarat Titans in IPL 2025, a run it will be looking to continue this afternoon. In the first of those two meetings in Lucknow, Shubman Gill and B. Sai Sudharsan scored fifties to help GT post 180 for six before Aiden Markram and Nicholas Pooran led the reply as LSG won by six wickets.Their meeting in Ahmedabad was dominated by Mitchell Marsh, who smoked 117 from 64 balls with 10 fours and eight sixes as LSG scored 235 for two before Will O’Rourke’s three-wicket haul helped it leave GT 33 runs short. Gujarat Titans -- results so far Punjab Kings vs Gujarat Titans - Punjab Kings won by three wicketsGujarat Titans vs Rajasthan Royals - Rajasthan Royals by six runsDelhi Capitals vs Gujarat Titans - Gujarat Titans won by one run Lucknow Super Giants -- results so far Lucknow Super Giants vs Delhi Capitals - Delhi Capitals won by six wicketsSunrisers Hyderabad vs Lucknow Super Giants - Lucknow Super Giants won by five wicketsKolkata Knight Riders vs Lucknow Super Giants - Lucknow Super Giants won by three wickets Last time out: Gujarat Titans sneaks a thriller Gujarat Titans secured its first win of the season with a nailbiting one-run victory the night prior over Delhi Capitals at the Arun Jaitley Stadium in Delhi. After being put in by the host, half-centuries from Shubman Gill, Washington Sundar, and Jos Buttler helped GT post 210 for four in 20 overs.KL Rahul anchored the DC chase with 92 from 52 balls, but David Miller was forced to off with a hand injury. Rahul’s dismissal though, brought the South African back, and he managed to change the equation from 45 needed off 18 balls to two in two. On the penultimate ball, he refused a single that would have given Kuldeep Yadav strike, and missed the final ball resulting in Kuldeep’s run-out and a one-run victory for GT. Last time out: Mukul's heroics fire LSG to victory Lucknow Super Giants secured its second consecutive victory against Kolkata Knight Riders at the Eden Gardens in Kolkata in its last match thanks to the heroics of Mukul Choudhary, who announced himself on the IPL stage with an unbeaten 54 from 27 delivieries. Needed 54 from the final four balls with Avesh Khan for company, Mukul carted the KKR bowling attack all over the ground with some eye-catchingly wristy strokes, and a scrambled bye from the final delivery of the match was enough to secure a three-wicket win for the visitor. Gujarat Titans full squad Shubman Gill (c), Sai Sudharsan, Kumar Kushagra, Anuj Rawat, Jos Buttler, Nishant Sindhu, Washington Sundar, Glenn Phillips, Arshad Khan, Shahrukh Khan, Rahul Tewatia, Kagiso Rabada, Mohammed Siraj, Prasidh Krishna, Ishant Sharma, Gurnoor Singh Brar, Rashid Khan, Manav Suthar, Sai Kishore, Jayant Yadav, Ashok Sharma, Jason Holder, Tom Banton, Kulwant Khejroliya, Luke Wood. Lucknow Super Giants full squad Abdul Samad, Ayush Badoni, Aiden Markram, Matthew Breetzke, Himmat Singh, Rishabh Pant (c), Nicholas Pooran, Mitchell Marsh, Shahbaz Ahmed, Arshin Kulkarni, Mayank Yadav, Avesh Khan, Mohsin Khan, Manimaran Siddharth, Digvesh Rathi, Prince Yadav, Akash Singh, Mohammed Shami, Arjun Tendulkar, George Linde, Anrich Nortje, Mukul Choudhary, Naman Tiwari, Akshat Raghuwanshi, Josh Inglis.
